findings.finding: v2r5 constructor-only readiness did not exercise the first registered materialization surface, so an empty March score frame consumed a claim.
findings.root_cause: March has 4,464 keys in each target layer but zero finite target-temperature truth keys in layers 2, 3, and 4.
findings.closure: A held-byte aggregate-only finite-mask certificate now runs before any claim and deterministically resolves to NO_GO_INNER_WINDOW_UNIDENTIFIABLE.

findings.finding: Dropping or replacing March after observing the missing truth would change the preregistered 18-cell selection.
findings.closure: The prospective trigger resolution forbids replacement, dropping, reweighting, or scoring the empty window as no-op and permanently blocks v2r6 execution.

findings.finding: v2r5 retained only a worker stderr hash, losing the exception type, message, phase, and frames.
findings.closure: v2r6 supplies a bounded sanitized value-free error envelope with create-only durable publication and held-byte parent binding for future separately preregistered workers; v2r6 itself launches none.

findings.finding: Windows os.open text mode translates LF to CRLF and breaks canonical receipt identity even when fsync succeeds.
findings.closure: Receipt and barrier descriptors include O_BINARY on Windows; the actual Windows publication and roundtrip identity test passes.

findings.finding: A blocked successor must not leave an executable claim/worker/materialization path.
findings.closure: The runner has no claim acquisition, worker launch, internal worker, materializer execution, scorer execution, or aggregate publication function. The execute flag only replays preflight and raises.

findings.finding: The blocked result must not be bypassable by changing an authorization flag.
findings.closure: Authorization is permanently false, semantically tied to the frozen design and seal, and any true swap is rejected.

findings.finding: Readiness must not resolve or inspect p100 or official/candidate paths.
findings.closure: The blocked runner contains no p100 literal path, reports p100 filesystem accesses zero, resolves only P2_DATA_DIR/observations.csv and the historical exact anchor, and produces no candidate or upload.

terminal_resolution.next: Only a separately preregistered Cycle2 may proceed.
